    5. Initializes an integer array x of size 100.
    6. Reads n integers from the user and stores them in the array x.
    7. Iterates over each integer in the array x.
    8. For each integer, attempts to reduce it to zero by subtracting the largest possible denomination available, updating the count of that denomination.
    9. If a denomination can be used, it is subtracted from the integer, and the count of that denomination is decremented.
    10. If the integer cannot be reduced to zero using the available denominations, sets ans to false and breaks the loop.
    11. After processing all integers, checks the value of ans.
    12. Prints "Yes" if ans is true, indicating all integers were reduced to zero.
    13. Prints "false" if ans is false, indicating at least one integer could not be reduced to zero (bug is here).
]
